extraSections.heading: Kenapa Pilih Kami untuk Servis Aircond Murah KL?
extraSections.text: 01 · RK Reno SolutionKenapa Pilih Kami untuk Servis Aircond Murah KL?Cuaca panas terik di Malaysia membuatkan aircond yang rosak atau kurang sejuk menjadi satu igauan ngeri. Anda perlukan juruteknik yang boleh dipercayai untuk menyediakan Servis Aircond Murah KL tanpa sebarang kos tersembunyi yang membebankan. RK Reno Solution adalah pakar tempatan anda untuk segala masalah penyaman udara di sekitar Kuala Lumpur.Kami meliputi seluruh kawasan utama KL seperti Wangsa Maju, Setapak, Cheras, Bangsar, Kepong, dan Bukit Bintang. Sama ada anda menghadapi masalah air menitik (leaking), kipas bising, bil elektrik melambung, atau sekadar ingin membuat servis berkala, kami jamin hasil kerja yang memuaskan. Tambahan pula, servis kami merangkumi semua jenama utama seperti Daikin, Panasonic, Acson, dan York.Senarai Harga Servis Aircond Murah KL (2026)Anggaran untuk unit wall-mounted 1.0HP–2.5HP di Kuala Lumpur. Skop dan keadaan unit menentukan harga akhir.Jenis Servis AircondAnggaran Harga (RM)Normal Service (Cuci Biasa) — penapis, cover luar dan blowerRM 60 – RM 80Chemical Wash (Overhaul) — cucian mendalamRM 120 – RM 150Top Up Gas (R32 / R410A)RM 50 – RM 120, bergantung pada bacaan PSIPemeriksaan & TroubleshootingRM 50 – RM 80 caj pemeriksaanSenarai Harga Servis Aircond Murah KL (2026)Kami mengamalkan polisi harga yang sangat telus. Berikut adalah anggaran harga untuk perkhidmatan penyelenggaraan dan cucian penyaman udara (untuk Wall Mounted 1.0HP - 2.5HP) di sekitar Kuala Lumpur:Jenis Servis AircondAnggaran Harga (RM)Normal Service (Cuci Biasa)Mencuci penapis (filter), cover luar, dan membersihkan blower dari habuk.RM 60 - RM 80Chemical Wash (Overhaul)Cucian mendalam menggunakan cecair kimia untuk mencairkan lendir (jelly block) dan mematikan bakteria.RM 120 - RM 150Top Up Gas (R32 / R410A)Menambah tekanan gas pendingin untuk mengembalikan kesejukan maksimum unit anda.RM 50 - RM 120 (Bergantung pada bacaan PSI)Pemeriksaan & TroubleshootingMemeriksa punca kerosakan teknikal (spt. kapasitor rosak, air menitik, lampu berkelip).RM 50 - RM 80 (Caj pemeriksaan)Harga Bajet, Kualiti PremiumKami memahami keperluan anda untuk mendapatkan rumah yang selesa dan sejuk tanpa membakar poket. Pakej "Murah" kami direka khas untuk mesra bajet. Walau bagaimanapun, kami tetap mengekalkan standard kebersihan dan keselamatan teknikal tertinggi untuk memastikan jangka hayat aircond anda lebih tahan lama.Pakej Servis Aircond Murah KL KamiKami bersedia menyelesaikan sebarang masalah aircond di Lembah Klang melalui perkhidmatan berikut: General Service: Pembersihan rutin untuk membuang debu tebal, memulihkan kelajuan angin, dan menjimatkan bil elektrik. Chemical Wash: Sesuai untuk aircond yang bocor menitiskan air. Kami mencuci 'indoor coil' dan saluran paip buang air menggunakan pam tekanan tinggi. Top-up & Tukar Gas: Mengukur dan menambah gas jenis R32, R410A, atau R22 agar suhu bilik anda kembali sejuk beku. Pembaikan Kerosakan (Repair): Menyelesaikan masalah lampu timer berkelip, kipas luar tidak berpusing, dan penukaran 'capacitor' atau 'pcb board' yang rosak.Tempah Slot Servis Hari IniProses Kerja Kami yang Sistematik1. Temujanji & Diagnosis AwalPertama, hubungi kami melalui WhatsApp. Nyatakan masalah aircond anda (contoh: aircond tak sejuk, air menitik) dan kami akan memberikan anggaran sebut harga yang telus.2. Perlindungan Ruang & CucianSeterusnya, setibanya di rumah anda, kami akan melindungi perabot dan dinding berhampiran dengan plastik pelindung. Unit akan dicuci dengan teliti menggunakan pam bertekanan tinggi.3. Pemeriksaan Tekanan Gas (PSI)Kemudian, juruteknik kami akan memeriksa tekanan gas pada unit kompresor di luar. Jika bacaan gas rendah atau berkurangan, kami akan syorkan top-up untuk memastikan penyejukan optimum.4. Ujian, Pembersihan Akhir & WarantiAkhir sekali, kami menghidupkan aircond untuk menguji tahap kesejukan dan kelancaran aliran air keluar. Kawasan kerja dibersihkan dan kami mengeluarkan resit bersama waranti servis untuk anda.Sebut Harga Servis Aircond KLMencari juruteknik untuk Servis Aircond Murah KL? extraAccordions: Berapa harga purata servis aircond murah KL?+Harga kami sangat berpatutan bermula dari RM 60 ke RM 80 untuk cucian biasa (general service) bagi unit 1.0HP. Walau bagaimanapun, harga untuk chemical wash dan top-up gas bergantung pada saiz HP dan tahap kekurangan gas aircond anda.

Kenapa aircond saya keluar air menitik (leaking) di dalam bilik?+Masalah air menitik selalunya disebabkan oleh saluran paip pembuangan air (drain pipe) atau takung air (drain pan) yang telah tersumbat dengan lendir habuk atau "jelly". Pakej Servis Chemical Wash kami akan membuang sumbatan ini serta-merta dan menyelesaikan masalah bocor.

Adakah RK Reno cover kawasan selain Kuala Lumpur?+Ya! Pasukan teknikal kami bersedia meliputi seluruh Lembah Klang. Ini termasuk pusat bandar Kuala Lumpur, Wangsa Maju, Bangsar, Setiawangsa, serta kawasan Petaling Jaya, Shah Alam, dan Subang Jaya di Selangor.

Berapa kerap saya perlu panggil orang servis aircond?+Untuk penggunaan rumah biasa (dipasang pada waktu malam sahaja), kami mengesyorkan servis cuci biasa setiap 3 ke 4 bulan, dan chemical wash setahun sekali. Sebaliknya, jika aircond dipasang siang dan malam atau di lokasi berhabuk, servis perlu dilakukan lebih kerap.

Adakah anda menyediakan jaminan (warranty) selepas servis?+Ya. Kami amat menjaga kualiti kerja kami. Setiap servis cucian dan pembaikan didatangkan dengan jaminan mutu kerja (workmanship warranty) selama 30 hingga 90 hari bergantung kepada jenis alat ganti atau kerosakan yang dibaiki.
Pusat Pengetahuan Penyaman Udara+Terma dan carian berkaitan Servis Aircond Murah KL:
extraCards: Senarai Harga Servis Aircond Murah KL (2026)Kami mengamalkan polisi harga yang sangat telus. Berikut adalah anggaran harga untuk perkhidmatan penyelenggaraan dan cucian penyaman udara (untuk Wall Mounted 1.0HP - 2.5HP) di sekitar Kuala Lumpur:Jenis Servis AircondAnggaran Harga (RM)Normal Service (Cuci Biasa)Mencuci penapis (filter), cover luar, dan membersihkan blower dari habuk.RM 60 - RM 80Chemical Wash (Overhaul)Cucian mendalam menggunakan cecair kimia untuk mencairkan lendir (jelly block) dan mematikan bakteria.RM 120 - RM 150Top Up Gas (R32 / R410A)Menambah tekanan gas pendingin untuk mengembalikan kesejukan maksimum unit anda.RM 50 - RM 120 (Bergantung pada bacaan PSI)Pemeriksaan & TroubleshootingMemeriksa punca kerosakan teknikal (spt. kapasitor rosak, air menitik, lampu berkelip).RM 50 - RM 80 (Caj pemeriksaan)

Harga Bajet, Kualiti PremiumKami memahami keperluan anda untuk mendapatkan rumah yang selesa dan sejuk tanpa membakar poket. Pakej "Murah" kami direka khas untuk mesra bajet. Walau bagaimanapun, kami tetap mengekalkan standard kebersihan dan keselamatan teknikal tertinggi untuk memastikan jangka hayat aircond anda lebih tahan lama.

Pakej Servis Aircond Murah KL KamiKami bersedia menyelesaikan sebarang masalah aircond di Lembah Klang melalui perkhidmatan berikut: General Service: Pembersihan rutin untuk membuang debu tebal, memulihkan kelajuan angin, dan menjimatkan bil elektrik. Chemical Wash: Sesuai untuk aircond yang bocor menitiskan air. Kami mencuci 'indoor coil' dan saluran paip buang air menggunakan pam tekanan tinggi. Top-up & Tukar Gas: Mengukur dan menambah gas jenis R32, R410A, atau R22 agar suhu bilik anda kembali sejuk beku. Pembaikan Kerosakan (Repair): Menyelesaikan masalah lampu timer berkelip, kipas luar tidak berpusing, dan penukaran 'capacitor' atau 'pcb board' yang rosak.Tempah Slot Servis Hari Ini
Proses Kerja Kami yang Sistematik
1. Temujanji & Diagnosis AwalPertama, hubungi kami melalui WhatsApp. Nyatakan masalah aircond anda (contoh: aircond tak sejuk, air menitik) dan kami akan memberikan anggaran sebut harga yang telus.

2. Perlindungan Ruang & CucianSeterusnya, setibanya di rumah anda, kami akan melindungi perabot dan dinding berhampiran dengan plastik pelindung. Unit akan dicuci dengan teliti menggunakan pam bertekanan tinggi.

3. Pemeriksaan Tekanan Gas (PSI)Kemudian, juruteknik kami akan memeriksa tekanan gas pada unit kompresor di luar. Jika bacaan gas rendah atau berkurangan, kami akan syorkan top-up untuk memastikan penyejukan optimum.

4. Ujian, Pembersihan Akhir & WarantiAkhir sekali, kami menghidupkan aircond untuk menguji tahap kesejukan dan kelancaran aliran air keluar. Kawasan kerja dibersihkan dan kami mengeluarkan resit bersama waranti servis untuk anda.

Copper pipe melebihi 5 kaki: Caj dikira berdasarkan panjang tambahan dan HP aircond. Wiring melebihi 5 kaki: Caj tambahan dikenakan berdasarkan ukuran dan jenis kerja. Outdoor unit di tempat tinggi: Akses sukar boleh memerlukan alat atau tenaga kerja tambahan. Cabut atau pindah aircond lama: Kerja dismantle dan relocation bukan sebahagian daripada harga asas. Hacking atau concealed piping: Kerja menanam paip dalam dinding memerlukan quotation berasingan. Point elektrik baru: Wiring dari DB box atau pemasangan suis baru dicaj berasingan. Minta penerangan tentang proses vacuum dan testing sebelum kerja bermula. 12. Kenapa Pilih RK Reno Solution? Back-to-back biasanya bermaksud indoor unit dan outdoor unit dipasang berdekatan pada dinding yang sama, jadi laluan paip lebih pendek. Adakah servis tersedia untuk pejabat dan kedai? missingAccordions: Does RK Reno accept small renovation jobs in KL?Yes. Customers can request smaller scopes such as painting, tile repair, bathroom improvement, wall repair or selected maintenance work. Availability and minimum charges depend on location and job size.

How much does a basic condo refresh cost?A limited cosmetic refresh may start around RM8,000. This is not a full-unit renovation. Final cost depends on unit size, painting, repairs, flooring, management rules and selected materials.
How much does painting one room cost?A basic room repaint may start around RM400. Room size, wall condition, paint brand, coats and repair work affect the final quotation.

How much does bathroom renovation cost?A limited bathroom refresh may start around RM3,000, while an entry-level fuller renovation may start around RM6,000. Waterproofing, plumbing, tiles and sanitary fittings can increase the cost.
How much does a basic kitchen renovation cost?An entry-level kitchen renovation may start around RM15,000. Cabinet length, countertop, appliances, plumbing, tiling and hacking affect the final price.

Do condo renovations require management approval?Many condos require renovation forms, contractor registration, deposits, lift protection and compliance with approved working hours. Customers should confirm the building rules before work begins.

Do structural changes require approval?Some extensions, structural changes and major alterations may require drawings or approval from the relevant authority. Requirements depend on the property and work scope.

Can I get an initial estimate without a site visit?An initial estimate may be possible using clear photos, videos, measurements, location and a detailed work list. A site review may still be required before confirming the final quotation.

What should be included in the quotation?The quotation should identify the work scope, materials, quantities, exclusions, disposal, payment stages, repair responsibilities and possible additional charges.

missingAccordions: How much does office renovation cost in Kuala Lumpur?A light office refresh may start around RM30 per sq ft, while a basic fit-out may start around RM50 per sq ft. These are planning figures only. Partitions, electrical work, data cabling, furniture, aircond, building rules and material choices affect the final quotation.

How much does office reinstatement cost?A basic reinstatement may start around RM20 per sq ft. The lease, landlord checklist, existing tenant improvements, hacking, disposal and final inspection requirements can increase the cost.

Can RK Reno handle a small office refresh?Small offices may request selected painting, flooring, lighting or partition work. Availability and minimum charges depend on the building location and actual scope.
What should I send for an initial quote?Send the building name, location, floor area, floor plan, existing photos, required rooms, workstations, services and expected budget range.

Does an office renovation require management approval?Many commercial buildings require renovation applications, deposits, contractor information, access arrangements and compliance with approved working hours. Confirm the specific building rules before work starts.

Can work be done outside normal office hours?The possible work schedule depends on the building's approved hours, the type of work and team availability. Do not assume night or weekend work is allowed until management approval is confirmed.

What is included in office reinstatement?The scope may include removing partitions, flooring, ceiling items, wiring or tenant fixtures and repairing or repainting retained surfaces. The landlord's handover checklist should define the final scope.

How should I compare office renovation quotations?Compare the same layout, quantities, material specifications, electrical and data scope, disposal, protection, exclusions and payment stages. A lower total may exclude important work.

extraAccordions: How much does a plaster ceiling cost in KL?+For a basic flat plaster ceiling, prices start from RM 3.50 to RM 6.00 per square foot. However, specialty designs like L-Boxes or Light Troughs are calculated per foot run (fr). Please refer to our detailed cost table above or contact us for a free quote.

Do you install the wiring and downlights as well?+Our core expertise is the structural ceiling construction and finishing. We will cut the precise holes for your downlights according to your layout. We can easily coordinate with our in-house wireman to pull the cables and install the lights simultaneously for you.

Is plaster ceiling durable against water leaks?+Standard gypsum board is not waterproof and will sag if exposed to continuous water. If you are installing a ceiling in a bathroom, wet kitchen, or under a concrete slab prone to leaking, we highly recommend using specialized moisture-resistant plasterboards (usually green in color) and ensuring your waterproofing is intact first.

How much will the new ceiling lower my room height?+To safely accommodate the aluminium frame, downlight casings, and electrical wiring, the ceiling typically needs to be dropped by a minimum of 4 to 6 inches from the original concrete slab. We will measure your site to ensure you still retain a spacious, airy feel in the room.

Is the installation process very dusty?+Yes, sanding the plaster stopping compound to achieve a perfectly smooth finish does create fine dust. We highly advise covering all furniture with plastic sheets beforehand. Our team will do our best to minimize the mess and clean up the work area upon completion.

extraSections.heading: Commercial Retail Shop Renovation in Kuala Lumpur
extraSections.text: Post by raoisrar Apr 04 2026 No Comments Commercial › Retail › Kuala Lumpur Commercial Retail Shop Renovation in Kuala Lumpur By RK Commercial Fit-Out Team 7 Minute Read Kuala Lumpur, MY In the highly competitive retail landscape of Kuala Lumpur, your storefront is your most powerful marketing tool. A well-designed shop does not just display products; it pulls foot traffic from the concourse, immerses the buyer in your brand, and directly increases sales conversions. However, executing a flawless retail shop renovation in a bustling mall or a premium shop lot requires far more than just good design. It demands a contractor who understands the rigorous logistics of commercial build-outs. From navigating strict mall management protocols and securing DBKL approvals to ensuring absolute fire safety (Bomba) compliance, the stakes are incredibly high. Every day of delay means lost rental money and lost revenue. At RK Reno Solution, we specialize in high-speed, high-quality commercial space renovation. Whether you are launching a flagship boutique in Bukit Bintang, a trendy F&B outlet in TRX, or a lifestyle store in Mid Valley Megamall, our team delivers stunning retail fit-outs on time and within budget. Table of Contents 1. The Unique Challenges of Retail Fit-Outs 2. Our Core Retail Renovation Services 3. 2026 Retail Shop Renovation Cost Guide 4. Our Fast-Track Commercial Workflow 5. Why Retail Brands Trust RK Reno 1. The Unique Challenges of Retail Fit-Outs Unlike a standard house renovation, building a retail shop in Kuala Lumpur’s top commercial zones comes with strict regulatory and logistical hurdles. As experienced commercial contractors, we expertly handle: Mall Management Approvals: Premium malls have exhaustive fit-out guidelines. We submit all required architectural, M&E (Mechanical & Electrical), and structural drawings for fast approval. Bomba (Fire Safety) Compliance: Your shop must pass strict fire safety inspections. We ensure your sprinklers, smoke detectors, and emergency lighting meet all local regulations. After-Hours Execution: To prevent disrupting mall operations, almost all noisy works (hacking, drilling, material loading) must be done between 10:00 PM and 8:00 AM. Our teams are optimized for night-shift execution. Hoarding Installation: We install mall-approved temporary hoarding boards with custom graphics so you can market your brand even while construction is ongoing. 2. Our Core Retail Renovation Services A successful commercial space renovation requires a harmonious blend of aesthetics and durability. We offer end-to-end services to bring your brand to life: Comprehensive Fit-Out Solutions Custom Carpentry & Fixtures: We build bespoke display racks, immersive island counters, and ergonomic Point-of-Sale (POS) cashier desks designed specifically for high-volume retail transactions. Lighting Design: Retail is all about lighting. We install strategic track lighting, concealed LED strips, and focal spotlights that dramatically enhance your product displays and draw customers in. Commercial Flooring: Heavy foot traffic demands highly durable flooring. We install commercial-grade SPC flooring, heavy-duty vinyl, polished concrete, and premium epoxy coatings. HVAC & Electrical: From complex electrical wiring for signage and displays to specialized air-conditioning (cassette/VRV) installation, our M&E team ensures your shop remains safe and comfortable. Opening a New Branch in Kuala Lumpur? Don't let contractor delays eat into your rental period. Contact our commercial team for a fast, accurate fit-out quotation. Get a Free Commercial Quote 3. 2026 Retail Shop Renovation Cost Guide Every retail brand has different requirements—a high-end jewelry boutique will cost significantly more per square foot than a minimalist clothing store. Below is an estimated cost guide for a retail shop renovation in Kuala Lumpur based on current 2026 market rates: Retail Fit-Out Tier Estimated Cost (RM) What’s Typically Included? Basic Refresh RM 50 - RM 90 per sqft New flooring, fresh painting, basic track lighting, and minor electrical point updates. (Ideal for pop-up stores). Standard Retail Store RM 120 - RM 200 per sqft Custom POS counter, standard display shelving, M&E works, plaster ceiling, and commercial flooring. Premium / Flagship Boutique RM 250 - RM 400+ per sqft High-end custom carpentry, intricate storefront facade, premium lighting design, smart-store integration, and complex M&E routing. Shop Reinstatement RM 15 - RM 40 per sqft Hacking displays, removing flooring, and restoring the commercial unit to a bare condition for handover to the landlord. 4. Our Fast-Track Commercial Workflow In the retail sector, time is your most expensive asset. We utilize a strict, fast-track workflow to guarantee your store opens on schedule: Step 1: Space Planning & Branding: We review your floor plan and brand guidelines to optimize customer flow and product visibility. Step 2: Quotation & Mall Submissions: We provide a transparent, itemized quote. Once approved, we rapidly compile and submit all necessary structural and M&E drawings to the mall management or DBKL. Step 3: Off-Site Fabrication: To save time, all custom carpentry (racks, counters) is built in our factory while our on-site team handles the hacking, wiring, and ceiling works. Step 4: Installation & Handover: The custom fixtures are transported and installed on-site. After a final industrial clean and defect check, we hand over the keys for your grand opening. 5. Why Retail Brands Trust RK Reno Solution When undertaking a commercial space renovation, you need a contractor with a proven track record. Delays due to failed mall inspections or poor project management can push your grand opening back by weeks. Our Commercial Guarantee We provide dedicated project managers for every commercial build. From coordinating with your interior designers to managing night-shift logistics with mall security, we ensure a seamless, stress-free build-out. All our workmanship is backed by a solid warranty. Why Retail Brands Trust RK Reno 1. The Unique Challenges of Retail Fit-Outs Unlike a standard house renovation, building a retail shop in Kuala Lumpur’s top commercial zones comes with strict regulatory and logistical hurdles. As experienced commercial contractors, we expertly handle: Mall Management Approvals: Premium malls have exhaustive fit-out guidelines. We submit all required architectural, M&E (Mechanical & Electrical), and structural drawings for fast approval. Bomba (Fire Safety) Compliance: Your shop must pass strict fire safety inspections. We ensure your sprinklers, smoke detectors, and emergency lighting meet all local regulations. After-Hours Execution: To prevent disrupting mall operations, almost all noisy works (hacking, drilling, material loading) must be done between 10:00 PM and 8:00 AM. Our teams are optimized for night-shift execution. Hoarding Installation: We install mall-approved temporary hoarding boards with custom graphics so you can market your brand even while construction is ongoing. 2. Our Core Retail Renovation Services A successful commercial space renovation requires a harmonious blend of aesthetics and durability. We offer end-to-end services to bring your brand to life: Comprehensive Fit-Out Solutions Custom Carpentry & Fixtures: We build bespoke display racks, immersive island counters, and ergonomic Point-of-Sale (POS) cashier desks designed specifically for high-volume retail transactions. Lighting Design: Retail is all about lighting. We install strategic track lighting, concealed LED strips, and focal spotlights that dramatically enhance your product displays and draw customers in. Commercial Flooring: Heavy foot traffic demands highly durable flooring. We install commercial-grade SPC flooring, heavy-duty vinyl, polished concrete, and premium epoxy coatings. HVAC & Electrical: From complex electrical wiring for signage and displays to specialized air-conditioning (cassette/VRV) installation, our M&E team ensures your shop remains safe and comfortable. Opening a New Branch in Kuala Lumpur? Don't let contractor delays eat into your rental period. Contact our commercial team for a fast, accurate fit-out quotation. Get a Free Commercial Quote 3. 2026 Retail Shop Renovation Cost Guide Every retail brand has different requirements—a high-end jewelry boutique will cost significantly more per square foot than a minimalist clothing store. Below is an estimated cost guide for a retail shop renovation in Kuala Lumpur based on current 2026 market rates: Retail Fit-Out Tier Estimated Cost (RM) What’s Typically Included? Basic Refresh RM 50 - RM 90 per sqft New flooring, fresh painting, basic track lighting, and minor electrical point updates. (Ideal for pop-up stores). Standard Retail Store RM 120 - RM 200 per sqft Custom POS counter, standard display shelving, M&E works, plaster ceiling, and commercial flooring. Premium / Flagship Boutique RM 250 - RM 400+ per sqft High-end custom carpentry, intricate storefront facade, premium lighting design, smart-store integration, and complex M&E routing. Shop Reinstatement RM 15 - RM 40 per sqft Hacking displays, removing flooring, and restoring the commercial unit to a bare condition for handover to the landlord. 4. Our Fast-Track Commercial Workflow In the retail sector, time is your most expensive asset. We utilize a strict, fast-track workflow to guarantee your store opens on schedule: Step 1: Space Planning & Branding: We review your floor plan and brand guidelines to optimize customer flow and product visibility. Step 2: Quotation & Mall Submissions: We provide a transparent, itemized quote. Once approved, we rapidly compile and submit all necessary structural and M&E drawings to the mall management or DBKL. Step 3: Off-Site Fabrication: To save time, all custom carpentry (racks, counters) is built in our factory while our on-site team handles the hacking, wiring, and ceiling works. Step 4: Installation & Handover: The custom fixtures are transported and installed on-site. After a final industrial clean and defect check, we hand over the keys for your grand opening. 5. Your workspace is more than just desks and chairs; it is a critical tool for employee productivity and reflecting your brand identity to visiting clients. Finding a contractor that specializes in office renovation Petaling Jaya is vastly different from hiring a standard home renovator. Commercial fit-outs require strict adherence to fire safety regulations (Bomba), complex data cabling infrastructure, and the ability to work around the stringent operating hours set by high-rise building management. At RK Reno Solution, we deliver end-to-end corporate fit-outs and office reinstatement services across PJ. From the bustling tech hubs of Bandar Utama and Mutiara Damansara, to the established commercial centers in SS2 and Kelana Jaya, we build workspaces that inspire. Table of Contents 1. The Unique Demands of PJ Office Fit-Outs 2. Our Core Corporate Renovation Services 3. Estimated Office Renovation Cost Guide (2026) 4. Our 4-Step Seamless Fit-Out Process 5. Expert Office Reinstatement Works 1. The Unique Demands of PJ Office Fit-Outs A commercial renovation must balance aesthetics with functional infrastructure. When executing an office renovation Petaling Jaya project, we handle several critical challenges that amateur contractors overlook: MBPJ Compliance: All major commercial structural changes, partitioning, and facade upgrades require permits from the Majlis Bandaraya Petaling Jaya (MBPJ) to avoid operational shutdowns. Building Management Rules: High-rise towers in PJ have strict rules regarding material loading bays, refundable deposit limits, and noisy work restrictions (hacking and drilling usually restricted to weekends or after 8:00 PM). M&E Precision: Modern offices rely heavily on seamless Mechanical and Electrical (M&E) systems, requiring flawless CAT6 data cabling, server room cooling, and adequate aircond installation. 2. Our Core Corporate Renovation Services We provide comprehensive solutions to transform empty, bare units into fully functional corporate environments: Complete Office Fit-Out Solutions Glass & Gypsum Partitioning: We maximize your floor plan by installing sleek frameless glass panels for meeting rooms, and soundproof gypsum boards for manager cabins and pantries. Commercial Flooring: Installation of heavy-duty, anti-static office carpet tiles, durable vinyl plank flooring, or sleek epoxy coating for modern industrial-style offices. Data Cabling & Electrical: Structured network cabling for your workstations, secure server room setups, and energy-efficient LED lighting grid installations. Corporate Identity: Custom reception counters, built-in pantry cabinets, and professional interior painting to match your brand's specific color palette. Expanding Your Business in Petaling Jaya? Let us handle the heavy lifting. Get a transparent fit-out quotation and space planning consultation today. Discuss Your Office Layout 3. Estimated Office Renovation Cost Guide (2026) Budget forecasting is essential for any business expansion. Below is an estimated cost-per-square-foot guide for office renovation Petaling Jaya based on current 2026 material and labor rates: Fit-Out Category Estimated Cost (RM) What’s Included? Basic Refresh RM 40 - RM 70 per sqft Carpet installation, fresh interior repainting, and basic LED lighting updates. Standard Corporate Office RM 80 - RM 130 per sqft Gypsum board partitions, standard data/electrical cabling, pantry setup, AC installation, and carpets. Premium / Executive Fit-Out RM 150 - RM 250+ per sqft Frameless glass partitions, acoustic ceilings, custom reception desks, premium vinyl, and smart-office integration. extraSections.text: Post by raoisrar Mar 28 2026 No Comments Services › Maintenance › Waterproofing Waterproofing Contractor Kuala Lumpur: The Complete Guide to Stopping Leaks (2026) By RK Leak Detection Expert 10 Minute Read Kuala Lumpur, MY Water leakage is an insidious problem. It starts as a small yellow stain on your ceiling or peeling paint on a wall. Ignored for too long, it rots wooden structures, rusts steel beams, and causes toxic black mold to spread through your home. In Malaysia's torrential monsoon climate, the integrity of your roof and bathrooms is constantly tested. Finding a reliable Waterproofing Contractor Kuala Lumpur is critical because improper fixes—like just slapping a coat of silicone over a crack—will fail within months. At RK Reno Solution, we don't just patch leaks; we cure them. From modern PU injection to heavy-duty torch-on membranes, this guide explains how we permanently protect your property. Table of Contents 1. Common Leakage Areas in KL Homes 2. The Magic of PU Injection (No-Hack Method) 3. Torch-On Membrane for Flat Roofs 4. Our Leak Detection & Repair Process 5. 2026 Waterproofing Cost Guide 6. Why Choose RK Reno Solution? 1. Where is the Water Coming From? Before applying any waterproofing material, we must identify the source. Here are the three most common leakage points we encounter in Kuala Lumpur: Inter-Floor Leaks (Bathrooms) If you live in a condo or a double-storey house, a dripping plaster ceiling is usually caused by the bathroom directly above it. The original waterproof membrane beneath the bathroom tiles has degraded, allowing water to seep into the concrete slab. RC Flat Roofs & Balconies Reinforced Concrete (RC) roofs are prone to cracking due to thermal expansion (the extreme heat of the KL sun followed by cold rain). Water pools in these cracks and eventually seeps through. External Wall Seepage Heavy driving rain can penetrate porous brick walls or degraded exterior paint, causing the paint on your interior walls to bubble, peel, or grow mold. 2. The Magic of PU Injection (No-Hacking Required) In the past, fixing a leaking ceiling meant your contractor had to hack up the entire bathroom floor above it, re-apply cement, and lay new tiles. It was expensive, loud, and took weeks. Today, as a modern Waterproofing Contractor Kuala Lumpur, our go-to solution for concrete slab leaks is Polyurethane (PU) Injection. How PU Injection Works We drill small holes into the concrete slab where the leak is occurring. Using a high-pressure pump, we inject liquid polyurethane resin into the cracks. When the resin meets the trapped water inside the concrete, it reacts instantly—expanding up to 30 times its volume to form a tough, waterproof rubber seal that permanently blocks the water path. 3. Torch-On Membrane for Flat Roofs For large exposed areas like RC flat roofs or commercial gutters, PU injection is not enough. The surface needs a heavy-duty shield against standing water and UV rays. We use Torch-On Bituminous Membrane. This involves rolling out sheets of modified asphalt (bitumen) reinforced with polyester. We use a blowtorch to melt the underside of the sheet, fusing it directly to the concrete. This creates an impenetrable, flexible layer that can withstand structural movements and severe weather. Is Your Ceiling Turning Yellow? Don't wait for it to collapse. Get a professional leak assessment today. Book Free Inspection 4. Our Detection & Repair Process We do not guess where the water is coming from. Our systematic approach ensures we fix the root cause. Step 1: Visual & Moisture Inspection: We assess the damage and use moisture meters to track the path of the water inside the walls. Step 2: Method Selection: We advise if the situation requires PU Injection, a clear Nano-coating (for tiles), or a full membrane replacement. Step 3: Surface Preparation: Waterproofing will fail if applied to a dirty surface. We grind, clean, and dry the area completely. Step 4: Application: Our trained specialists apply the chosen waterproofing system. Step 5: Ponding Test: For bathrooms and roofs, we flood the area with water and leave it for 24-48 hours to ensure zero leaks before handover. 5. Waterproofing Cost Guide (KL 2026) Pricing depends heavily on the method used and the severity of the leak. extraSections.text: Post by raoisrar Mar 28 2026 No Comments Services › Interior Finishing › Ceiling Works Plaster Ceiling Contractor KL: The Ultimate Design & Pricing Guide (2026) By RK Finishing Expert 8 Minute Read Kuala Lumpur, MY The ceiling is the largest uninterrupted surface in your home or office, yet it is often the most overlooked. A well-designed plaster ceiling does more than just look good—it completely transforms the ambiance, improves acoustics, and hides unsightly wires. Whether you are renovating a high-end condominium in Mont Kiara or upgrading a commercial office in KL Sentral, finding a skilled Plaster Ceiling Contractor KL is essential. Poor craftsmanship leads to visible joint lines, sagging boards, and a finish that looks cheap when the lights turn on. At RK Reno Solution, we pride ourselves on delivering flawless ceiling finishes. This guide will walk you through the types of ceilings available, the installation process, and realistic 2026 pricing in Kuala Lumpur. Table of Contents 1. Popular Ceiling Designs in KL 2. The Flawless Installation Process 3. Integrating Lighting & Airconds 4. 2026 Cost & Price Guide 5. Solving Water Damage & Repairs 6. Why Choose RK Reno Solution? 1. Popular Plaster Ceiling Designs A plaster ceiling (or suspended gypsum board ceiling) offers endless design possibilities. Here are the most requested styles by our KL clients: The Flat Ceiling Minimalist and clean. A flat dropped ceiling is perfect for hiding electrical wiring, aircond copper piping, and uneven concrete slabs. It provides a seamless, modern look for any room. L-Box & Cove Lighting (Light Troughs) This is the secret to luxury interiors. An L-Box creates a recessed edge around the room's perimeter to hide LED strip lights. It casts a soft, warm glow (cove lighting) across the ceiling, eliminating harsh glares while acting as a stunning feature piece in living rooms and master bedrooms. Cornice Moldings For those who prefer a classic, Victorian, or European aesthetic. Plaster cornices are installed at the corner where the wall meets the ceiling, adding elegant architectural details. Grid Ceilings (For Commercial Offices) Often required for office renovations, 2'x4' acoustic grid ceilings are easy to maintain and allow quick access to server cables and centralized AC systems above. 2. The Flawless Installation Process What separates a professional Plaster Ceiling Contractor KL from an amateur is the preparation and finishing process. Step 1: Metal Framing: We never use cheap wood that can rot or attract termites. We construct a rigid galvanized aluminium suspension framework anchored securely to the concrete slab above. Step 2: Boarding: We screw high-quality 9mm gypsum boards to the frame. For wet areas like bathrooms and kitchens, we strictly use moisture-resistant (green) boards. Step 3: Jointing & Skimming: This is the most crucial step. We apply fibrous tape over the joints and cover them with a special stopping compound. We sand it down perfectly smooth so that the joints become invisible. Step 4: Painting: The final touch is applying a primer and two coats of premium matte ceiling paint to hide minor imperfections and reduce light reflection. 3. Integrating Lighting and Air Conditioning A ceiling isn't finished without the right utilities. We coordinate closely with our internal electrical and HVAC teams: Coordinated M&E Planning Before we seal the ceiling, we ensure all wiring for downlights, ceiling fans (requiring solid fan hooks), and aircond installation piping is perfectly positioned. We cut precise circular holes for recessed lights, ensuring no damage to the freshly painted surface. Transform Your Living Space Want an L-Box ceiling with elegant cove lighting? Let our experts design it for you. Get a Free Quote Today 4. Plaster Ceiling Cost Guide (KL 2026) Pricing for plaster ceiling work is generally calculated by square footage (sqft) for flat ceilings, and by foot run (fr) for designs and borders. Here is a standard market guide: Ceiling Type / Service Estimated Pricing (2026) Flat Plaster Ceiling RM 3.50 - RM 5.00 per sqft Moisture Resistant (Bathrooms) RM 4.50 - RM 6.00 per sqft L-Box / Light Trough RM 15.00 - RM 22.00 per foot run Cornice Installation RM 8.00 - RM 15.00 per foot run Lighting Hole Cut-out RM 10.00 - RM 15.00 per hole *Note: Prices vary depending on the total volume of work, ceiling height, and site accessibility. 5. Solving Water Damage and Sagging If you live in a multi-story condo or a landed house with roof issues, water damage is a common threat. extraSections.text: Post by raoisrar Mar 28 2026 No Comments Services › HVAC Guides › Installation Aircond Installation KL: The Definitive Guide to Cooling Your Home (2026 Edition) By RK Reno Expert 10 Minute Read Kuala Lumpur, MY Living in Kuala Lumpur, the humidity can be suffocating. Whether you are moving into a new condo in Mont Kiara, renovating a terrace house in Cheras, or setting up an office in KLCC, one appliance is non-negotiable: The Air Conditioner. However, many property owners make a critical mistake. They spend thousands on a premium brand unit but look for the cheapest Aircond Installation KL service they can find. This often leads to leaking units, high electricity bills, and frequent breakdowns. At RK Reno Solution, we believe in doing it right the first time. This comprehensive guide covers everything you need to know about installing air conditioning in Malaysia. Table of Contents 1. Choosing the Right HP Size 2. Inverter vs Non-Inverter 3. The Installation Process 4. 2026 Cost Breakdown 5. Top Brands in Malaysia 6. Why Choose RK Reno 1. Choosing the Right Size: Calculating HP The most common question we get is: "Is 1.0HP enough for my room?" If you install a unit that is too small, the compressor will run continuously at maximum power, leading to massive electricity bills and early failure. If the unit is too big, it will "short cycle" (turn on and off too quickly), leaving the room feeling damp and humid. The General Rule of Thumb for KL Weather In Malaysia, due to our high ambient temperature, we recommend a higher cooling capacity than Western standards. Use this guide: Room Size (Sq. Ft.) Recommended HP Typical Room Type Up to 150 sqft 1.0 HP Small Bedroom / Study Room 151 - 250 sqft 1.5 HP Master Bedroom 251 - 400 sqft 2.0 HP Living Hall / Dining Area 401 - 600 sqft 2.5 HP Large Living Hall / Open Plan Office Pro Tip: If your room faces the sunset (West) or has large glass windows, you should upgrade to the next HP level to combat the extra heat load. 2. Inverter vs. Non-Inverter: Is it Worth It? When browsing for a new unit, you will see a significant price difference between Inverter and Non-Inverter models. Is the extra RM 300 - RM 500 worth it? How Non-Inverter Works A non-inverter motor runs at 100% speed until the room is cold, then shuts off completely. When the room warms up, it blasts at 100% again. This "Stop-Start" motion consumes a lot of electricity—similar to driving a car in heavy traffic. How Inverter Works An inverter motor varies its speed. Once the room is cold, it slows down to a low maintenance speed to keep the temperature steady. It never fully stops. This is like highway driving—smooth and efficient. Our Expert Recommendation Choose Inverter for bedrooms and living rooms where you use the AC for more than 4 hours a day. extraSections.text: Post by raoisrar Mar 28 2026 No Comments Services › Technical Guides › Wiring Electrical Services Selangor: The Complete Safety & Pricing Guide (2026 Edition) By RK Certified Wireman 8 Minute Read Selangor & KL Electricity is the silent heartbeat of your home. It powers your lights, your airconds, and your internet. But when it goes wrong, it isn't just an inconvenience—it's a serious fire hazard. Unlike painting or assembling furniture, electrical work is not a DIY job. Faulty wiring is the #1 cause of residential fires in Malaysia. Whether you are experiencing frequent power trips or planning a house renovation, you need a certified expert. If you are looking for professional Electrical Services Selangor, this guide will walk you through safety standards, rewiring processes, and realistic 2026 pricing. Table of Contents 1. Warning Signs of Bad Wiring 2. Key Electrical Services 3. DB Box & ELCB Safety 4. Do You Need 3-Phase Power? 5. 2026 Price Estimates 6. Why Choose RK Reno 1. Warning Signs: When to Call an Electrician Many homeowners ignore minor electrical issues until the power goes out completely. Here are critical signs that your property needs immediate attention: Frequent Power Trips: If your ELCB (main switch) trips every time you turn on the kettle or aircond, your circuit is overloaded. Burning Smell: A fishy or plastic burning smell near switches usually means wire insulation is melting due to overheating. Flickering Lights: This often indicates loose connections or voltage fluctuations. Discolored Outlets: Brown or black marks around a socket are signs of internal sparking (arcing). Safety Alert If you smell burning plastic, switch off your Main DB immediately and call an emergency wireman. Do not attempt to pour water on electrical components. 2. Our Core Electrical Services Selangor At RK Reno Solution, we provide end-to-end electrical solutions strictly adhering to Suruhanjaya Tenaga (ST) guidelines. A. Whole House Rewiring If your house is over 20 years old, the original rubber-insulated wiring has likely degraded. We replace old wires with modern PVC-insulated copper cables (SIRIM approved) to ensure safety and longevity. B. Socket & Point Installation We install new 13A power sockets, 15A aircond points, and 20A water heater points. We also handle concealed wiring (hacking and plastering) for a clean, wire-free look. C. Lighting & Fan Installation From intricate chandeliers to functional LED downlights and ceiling fans. We ensure proper hook installation so your fan doesn't wobble or fall. 3. The Heart of Safety: DB Box & ELCB Your Distribution Board (DB Box) is your home's first line of defense. The most critical component inside is the ELCB (Earth Leakage Circuit Breaker). Many older homes in Selangor still use outdated fuses or low-sensitivity ELCBs. To protect your family from electrocution, we recommend upgrading to: 30mA Sensitivity RCCB: Mandatory for power sockets and water heaters. It cuts power instantly if it detects a tiny leak (shock). 100mA Sensitivity RCCB: Suitable for fixed lighting circuits. Heavy Duty Main Switch: To handle modern load requirements. 4. Single Phase vs. 3-Phase Upgrade "My contractor told me to upgrade to 3-Phase. Do I really need it?" A standard Single Phase supply is usually sufficient for small families. However, you should consider upgrading to 3-Phase (415V) if: Scenario Recommended Supply Standard Terrace / Condo (2-3 Airconds) Single Phase Large Semi-D / Bungalow (5+ Airconds) 3-Phase Using Instant Water Heaters in 3+ Bathrooms 3-Phase EV Charger Installation (Tesla/BYD) 3-Phase (Highly Recommended) Note: Upgrading involves applying to TNB and changing the internal wiring board. We handle the entire process for you. Worried About Old Wiring? Get a free safety inspection and quote for your home in Selangor. WhatsApp Us Now 5. Electrical Services Selangor Price Guide (2026) Pricing for electrical work varies based on the hacking required, cable length, and brand of switches (e.g., Hager, Schneider, Simon). Below are market estimates: Installation Costs (Labour + Material) Lighting Point: RM 60 - RM 90 per point Fan Point: RM 70 - RM 100 per point (with hook) 13A Power Socket: RM 90 - RM 150 (looped/new circuit) 15A Aircond Point: RM 150 - RM 250 (from DB) Water Heater Point: RM 140 - RM 220 Major Works DB Box Upgrade: RM 450 - RM 800 (depending on size/components) Whole House Rewiring (Terrace): RM 3,500 - RM 8,000+ Troubleshooting / Inspection: RM 80 - RM 150 (Transportation & diagnosis) 6. Why Choose RK Reno Solution? Electrical work is about trust. You are trusting us to prevent fires and protect your appliances. Here is why thousands of Selangor residents choose us: Certified Wiremen: Our team is trained and experienced in residential & commercial wiring. Genuine Parts Only: We use 100% pure copper cables (Mega/Fajar) and authentic SIRIM-certified breakers. No cheap imitations. Transparent Quotes: We list every point and length. No hidden "urgent" fees. Warranty: We provide a warranty on workmanship to ensure your peace of mind. Don't gamble with electricity. Whether you need a simple fan installation or a complex 3-phase upgrade, RK Reno Solution delivers safety you can rely on. missingSections.text: Post by raoisrar Mar 28 2026 No Comments Services › Renovation › Cost Guide House Renovation in Kuala Lumpur: The Ultimate Planning & Cost Guide (2026) RK Technical Team Renovation Planning Guide Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia House renovation costs in Kuala Lumpur can start with a few hundred ringgit for one small room and rise substantially for kitchens, bathrooms, full-condo work or structural changes. The safest way to plan is to define the exact scope, separate essential work from optional finishes and request an itemised quotation. This guide provides low-entry starting estimates for painting, tiling, bathroom work, kitchen renovation and basic home refreshes. The figures are intended for early budget planning. They are not fixed packages because property condition, materials, access, hacking, disposal and building rules can change the final cost. For contractor services rather than general cost information, visit the House Renovation in Kuala Lumpur service page or the House Renovation in Selangor page. From RM400 Basic room repaint From RM3,000 Limited bathroom refresh From RM8,000 Basic cosmetic home refresh Renovation Cost Check Need an estimate for your actual property? Send your location, property type, photos, measurements and required work through WhatsApp. Request an Initial Estimate Current renovation image used on the RK Reno website. Replace with a verified project photo when available. Table of Contents 1. Quick Cost Answer 2. Cost by Renovation Scope 3. Room-by-Room Starting Prices 4. What Different Budgets May Cover 5. Condo vs Landed Renovation 6. What Changes the Price? 7. Renovation Work Sequence 8. Hidden and Extra Costs 9. How to Compare Quotations 10. Approvals and Building Rules 11. Renovation Cost FAQs 1. How Much Does House Renovation Cost in Kuala Lumpur? There is no single price for a house renovation because the word “renovation” can mean anything from repainting one room to rebuilding kitchens, bathrooms, electrical systems and internal layouts. Practical Budget Summary A small room refresh may begin from a few hundred ringgit. A limited bathroom refresh may start around RM3,000. A basic cosmetic condo or home refresh may start around RM8,000. Kitchens, full bathrooms, extensive hacking, new layouts and structural work require a larger measured quotation. Use these figures to decide whether your current budget matches a small repair, a room upgrade or a broader renovation. Do not treat a starting price as the final cost before the property and work scope have been reviewed. 2. Renovation Cost by Project Scope Start by deciding how much of the property you actually need to change. Reducing the scope is usually more effective than choosing the cheapest material for every item. Small Repair or Room Refresh From RM400 Suitable for a basic room repaint, selected wall repair, small fixture replacement or another clearly limited task. Basic Cosmetic Home Refresh From RM8,000 May cover selected painting, minor repairs or simple improvements. It does not mean a complete-property renovation. Full or Structural Renovation Measured Quote Required for major hacking, layout changes, extensions, full rewiring, roofing, several bathrooms or complete-property work. Do Not Compare Prices Without Comparing Scope One quotation may include hacking, disposal, waterproofing, wiring and materials while another includes labour only. A lower total does not always mean a lower price for the same work. 3. Room-by-Room Renovation Starting Prices The figures below use low-entry estimates to help customers start a conversation. Final quotations must be based on actual measurement and specifications. Painting One Room From RM400 Basic repaint for a small standard room Room size affects paint quantity and labour Cracks, peeling paint and moisture repair cost more Paint brand, colour changes and number of coats matter Tile Installation Labour From RM6/sq ft Basic labour estimate for a simple layout Tiles, adhesive and grout may be separate Hacking, disposal and levelling cost extra Large-format, mosaic or complex patterns cost more Limited Bathroom Refresh From RM3,000 Selected fittings, repairs or surface improvements Not a full bathroom rebuild Full hacking and waterproofing increase the price Sanitary fittings may be supplied separately Basic Bathroom Renovation From RM6,000 Entry-level fuller bathroom scope Tile and fitting choices affect the cost Plumbing changes may increase the quotation Waterproofing scope must be clearly stated Selected Kitchen Refresh From RM8,000 Limited cabinets, countertop or selected upgrades Not a complete kitchen replacement Cabinet length and material affect the total Appliances may not be included Basic Kitchen Renovation From RM15,000 Broader entry-level kitchen work Cabinet, countertop and backsplash scope matters Hacking and plumbing changes cost extra Appliances and premium accessories may be separate Important Pricing Note These prices represent different scopes. For example, a RM3,000 bathroom refresh is not the same work as a RM6,000 basic bathroom renovation. Ask for the exact inclusions before comparing prices. 4. What Different Renovation Budgets May Cover The examples below are not packages or promises. They show how project priorities may change at different budget levels. Budget Below RM5,000 Usually best for one clearly defined task, such as painting a room, selected wall repairs, minor tile work, fitting replacement or a limited bathroom refresh. Budget RM5,000 to RM15,000 May cover a cosmetic home refresh, a more complete bathroom scope, selected flooring or a limited kitchen refresh, depending on materials and property condition. Budget RM15,000 to RM30,000 May support a basic kitchen renovation, several cosmetic upgrades or a combination of selected rooms. Hacking and premium materials can reduce the amount covered. Budget Above RM30,000 Can be used for broader multi-room work, but complete-condo or landed-house renovations may require substantially more depending on scope and finishes. 5. Condo vs Landed House Renovation Costs Condo or Apartment Condo work may involve management approval, renovation deposits, restricted work hours, lift bookings, delivery procedures, floor protection and controlled debris removal. Confirm the management renovation form Check contractor registration requirements Ask about lift and loading access Confirm permitted hacking and work hours Landed House Landed homes may allow more access, but extensions, roof changes, new walls and structural alterations can require plans, engineering input or approval from the relevant authority. Check drainage and neighbouring properties Confirm whether the work is structural Include roofing and external waterproofing where needed Allow for larger disposal and material deliveries 6. What Changes the Final Renovation Price? Property condition: Water damage, old wiring, uneven floors and hidden plumbing issues can increase the scope. Hacking and disposal: Removing walls, cabinets or tiles adds labour, transport and debris costs. Material specifications: Cabinets, countertops, tiles, paint, sanitary fittings and hardware vary widely in price. Electrical and plumbing changes: New points, rewiring, concealed pipes and DB-board work should be separately identified. Waterproofing: Bathroom, balcony and roof work should clearly state surface preparation and waterproofing coverage. Access and building rules: High-rise logistics, restricted hours and lift protection may add time and cost. Design complexity: Curves, custom carpentry, hidden lighting and special tile patterns require more labour. 7. Correct Renovation Work Sequence Completing work in the wrong order can damage finished surfaces and create unnecessary rework. Planning & Approval Confirm scope, measurements, property rules, drawings and any required approval before physical work begins. Protection, Hacking & Disposal Protect retained surfaces, remove approved items and arrange safe debris collection. Wet Works, Plumbing & Electrical Complete concealed piping, wiring, wall changes, waterproofing and related preparation before closing surfaces. Ceiling, Tiling & Flooring Complete plaster ceiling, tile work, levelling and flooring according to the agreed sequence. Carpentry, Fixtures & Painting Install cabinets and fixtures, complete finishing paint and protect newly completed work. Testing, Touch-Up & Handover Test electrical, plumbing, drainage and other systems, then record and correct remaining defects. Living-area renovation and finishing example currently used on the website. Kitchen renovation and finishing example currently used on the website. 8. Hidden and Extra Renovation Costs A useful renovation budget includes more than the visible finishes. Hacking, loading and debris disposal Wall, floor or ceiling repair discovered after removal Condo deposits, access protection or management charges Temporary storage or moving furniture Electrical points, plumbing changes and waterproofing Delivery, lifting and parking restrictions Additional material caused by measurement changes or wastage Professional drawings or approval costs where required Keep a Contingency Budget Older homes and wet areas can reveal hidden damage only after tiles, ceilings or cabinets are removed. Keep part of the budget uncommitted until the risky areas have been inspected. 9. How to Compare Renovation Quotations Ask each contractor to quote the same work and specifications. Otherwise, the totals cannot be compared fairly. Work scope: Every room and task should be listed. Quantities: Include square feet, linear feet, units or item counts where possible. Materials: State brand, type, size, finish or allowance. Inclusions: Identify hacking, disposal, delivery, protection and cleanup. Exclusions: Clearly list items the customer must supply or pay separately. Payment stages: Link payments to agreed progress rather than vague dates. Variation process: Extra work should be priced and approved before it begins. Information to Send for a Faster Estimate Send the property location, type, room photos, short videos, approximate measurements, preferred finish, building rules and expected budget range. Better information usually produces a more useful initial estimate. 10. Renovation Approvals and Building Rules Minor cosmetic work and structural alterations should not be treated the same. Approval requirements depend on the property, building management, work type and relevant authority. For Condos and Apartments Check the JMB or management office rules before booking labour or material delivery. Many buildings require forms, deposits, contractor details, work-hour compliance and lift protection. For Landed Properties Check with the relevant authority or qualified professional before extensions, roof changes, additional floors, structural wall work or changes affecting drainage and boundaries. RK Reno should not promise approval services unless the exact submission responsibility has been confirmed for the specific project. Plan Your Renovation with a Clear Scope Send your property details, photos, measurements and target budget. RK Reno can review the initial information and advise the next step. WhatsApp for an Estimate Related Renovation and Property Services House Renovation Kuala Lumpur View the dedicated KL renovation contractor and lead-generation page. View KL Renovation Service House Renovation Selangor See services and starting prices for renovation work in Selangor. View Selangor Renovation Electrical Services Plan new points, rewiring and other electrical work during renovation. View Electrical Services Plaster Ceiling Review plaster-ceiling installation and related finishing work in KL. View Plaster Ceiling Service Waterproofing Address water-entry and leakage problems before installing new finishes. View Waterproofing Service Aircond Installation Coordinate new aircond installation while electrical and finishing work is planned. View Aircond Installation KL 11. House Renovation Cost FAQs What is the minimum cost to start a small renovation? A small, clearly limited job may begin from around RM400, such as a basic room repaint. The minimum charge still depends on location, preparation, materials and the amount of labour required. How much is a basic condo refresh in Kuala Lumpur? A limited cosmetic refresh may start around RM8,000. This is not a complete-unit renovation and may only cover selected painting, minor repairs or simple improvements. How much does bathroom renovation cost? A limited bathroom refresh may start around RM3,000, while a basic fuller renovation may start around RM6,000. Hacking, waterproofing, plumbing, tiles and sanitary fittings affect the final cost. How much does kitchen renovation cost? A selected kitchen refresh may start around RM8,000, while a broader basic kitchen renovation may start around RM15,000. Cabinet length, material, countertop, plumbing, hacking and appliances affect the total. Why are renovation quotations so different? Quotations may include different materials, quantities, preparation, disposal and finishing work. Compare the detailed scope rather than comparing only the final total. Should I keep money for unexpected work? Yes. Hidden leaks, old wiring, damaged floors and plumbing problems may only become visible after hacking or removal. Keep part of the budget available for approved variations. Do condo renovations require management approval? Many condos require renovation forms, contractor registration, deposits, lift protection and compliance with approved working hours. Check the building's rules before work starts. Do landed-house extensions require approval? Extensions, roof changes, additional floors and structural alterations may require drawings or approval. Confirm the exact requirement with the relevant authority or a qualified professional. Can I get a renovation estimate through WhatsApp? An initial estimate may be possible when you send clear photos, videos, measurements, location and the required work. A site review may still be needed before confirming the final quotation. extraSections.text: Post by raoisrar Mar 28 2026 No Comments Services › Renovation › Selangor Guide House Renovation in Selangor: The Ultimate 2026 Guide to Extending Your Home By RK Reno Expert 10 Minute Read Selangor, MY Selangor is home to some of the most vibrant townships in Malaysia. From the bustling streets of Subang Jaya to the spacious layouts of Shah Alam and the growing communities in Cyberjaya, renovating a home here offers incredible potential. However, managing a House Renovation in Selangor is vastly different from Kuala Lumpur. Each local council (Majlis) has its own set of strict bylaws regarding setbacks, extensions, and rubbish disposal. Without local knowledge, your dream project can stall indefinitely. At RK Reno Solution, we have over 10 years of experience navigating these waters. This guide covers everything from council approvals to cost breakdowns for 2026. Table of Contents 1. Navigating Selangor Councils 2. Our Core Services 3. The Renovation Process 4. 2026 Price Guide 5. Essential Renovation Tips 6. Why RK Reno Solution? 1. Navigating Selangor's Local Councils Unlike KL which is centralized under DBKL, Selangor is divided into various municipalities. Knowing which one you fall under is the first step to a legal renovation. Major Councils & Jurisdictions MBSJ (Subang Jaya / Puchong): Very strict on back extensions. Usually requires 10ft setback for 2nd floor. MBPJ (Petaling Jaya): Requires rigorous waste disposal permits (Tong RORO). MBSA (Shah Alam): Often requires a consistent façade design with neighbors in gated communities. MPK (Klang): Specific guidelines for older pre-war shop lots and terrace houses. 2. Our Core Renovation Services We provide a "Turnkey Solution," meaning we handle the dirty work, the technical wiring, and the fine finishing. You deal with one project manager, not ten different contractors. A. Wet Works & Extensions This is the backbone of any major renovation. We specialize in: Kitchen Extensions: Extending the back of terrace houses to maximize cooking space. Car Porch Upgrades: Re-tiling and column removal (structural beam installation) for more parking space. Brickwork & Plastering: Building new room partitions with high-quality red bricks or sand bricks. B. M&E (Mechanical & Electrical) A beautiful house is useless if the power trips. We coordinate electrical wiring and plumbing piping before tiling begins to ensure everything is concealed neatly. C. Finishing Works The final touches that make a house a home. This includes plaster ceilings with L-box lighting, 2x2 porcelain tiling, and weather-resistant exterior painting. 3. The Renovation Process: Concept to Keys How do we turn a bare unit into a showroom? Here is our proven workflow. Step 1: Consultation & Site Measurement We visit your site in Selangor to measure dimensions and inspect structural integrity (beams, columns, roof condition). We listen to your needs—do you need a wet kitchen? An extra bedroom? Step 2: Quotation & Material Selection We provide a transparent, itemized quote. We advise on material costs: Ceramic vs Porcelain tiles, Laminate vs Vinyl flooring. Step 3: Execution Once the deposit is paid and permits (if needed) are secured, work begins. We manage the "RORO bin" for debris removal to keep your neighbors happy. Step 4: Handover We conduct a joint inspection to ensure all defects are rectified before the final handover. Planning a Major Extension? Don't risk illegal structures. Get a professional consult and quote today. Get Your Quote 4. 2026 House Renovation Cost Guide (Selangor) Renovation costs depend heavily on the size of the extension and the luxury level of finishes. Below are estimates for standard terrace houses in Selangor. Project Type Est. Cost Range Duration Basic RefurbishmentPainting, Minor Repairs, Polishing RM 15k - RM 25k 2 - 3 Weeks Kitchen Extension (1 Storey)Piling, Brick wall, Roofing, Tiling RM 45k - RM 70k 6 - 8 Weeks Car Porch RenovationNew Tiles, Autogate wiring, Wall RM 15k - RM 30k 3 - 4 Weeks Full House MakeoverNew Flooring, 2 Bathrooms, Wiring RM 100k - RM 180k 3 - 4 Months 5. Essential Tips for Selangor Homeowners Check Your Title: Is your land Freehold or Leasehold? Some renovations on leasehold land require extra consent. Notify Neighbors: A friendly renovation is a smooth renovation. Informing neighbors about noise schedules prevents complaints to the Majlis. Plan for Wiring: Always install more power sockets than you think you need. Hacking walls later to add a point is messy and expensive. 6. Why Choose RK Reno Solution? We are not just contractors; we are your partners in building a home. With over 800+ homes built and renovated across Selangor, we bring reliability to an industry often plagued by delays. We offer: Itemized Billing: No lump sum "agak-agak" prices. Skilled Tradesmen: Dedicated teams for tiling, painting, and wiring. Warranty: We stand by our workmanship long after the project is done. extraSections.text: Post by raoisrar Mar 28 2026 No Comments Services › Commercial › Office Fit-Out Office Renovation in Kuala Lumpur: The 2026 Corporate Guide to Productivity By RK Project Director 9 Minute Read Kuala Lumpur, MY Your office is more than just a place to work; it is the physical embodiment of your brand. In Kuala Lumpur's competitive market, a modern, functional workspace is key to attracting top talent and impressing clients. However, managing an Office Renovation in Kuala Lumpur comes with unique challenges: strict Building Management rules, after-hours work restrictions, and tight deadlines. A delay of just one week can cost your business thousands in lost productivity. At RK Reno Solution, we specialize in commercial fit-outs that are on time, on budget, and compliant with Malaysian standards. Here is everything you need to know about renovating your workspace in 2026. Table of Contents 1. Permits & Management Compliance 2. Partitioning & Layouts 3. Commercial Flooring Options 4. Data Cabling & Electrical 5. Office Reinstatement (Moving Out) 6. 2026 Cost Guide 1. The Rules: Permits & Building Management Before you knock down a single wall, you must navigate the bureaucracy of KL office towers. This is where most inexperienced contractors fail. Mandatory Requirements Renovation Deposit: Most buildings require a refundable deposit (RM 2k - RM 10k) to cover potential damages to lifts or common areas. BOMBA Compliance: Partition layouts must not block fire sprinklers or emergency exits. We handle the submission for fire safety inspection. Working Hours: Noisy works (drilling, hacking) are often restricted to weekends or after 6 PM. 2. Partitioning: Gypsum vs. Glass Open-plan offices are popular, but privacy is still needed for meeting rooms and director cabins. We offer two main solutions: Gypsum Board Partition (Drywall) The most cost-effective solution. It provides decent sound insulation and can be painted to match your brand colors. Ideal for server rooms and store rooms. Tempered Glass Partition The modern standard for KL offices. Glass allows natural light to flow through the office, making small spaces feel larger. We use 10mm or 12mm tempered glass for safety, often with frosted stickers for privacy. 3. Commercial Flooring Options Your floor takes the most abuse. Choosing the right material is critical for maintenance and acoustics. Carpet Tiles (PP/Nylon): The industry standard. They absorb sound (reducing echo) and are easy to replace piece-by-piece if stained. Vinyl Click Flooring: Durable and waterproof. Perfect for pantries and high-traffic corridors. It mimics the look of wood without the maintenance. Epoxy Coating: Best for "Industrial Look" creative agencies or warehouse offices. 4. The Backbone: Data Cabling & Electrical A beautiful office is useless if the internet is slow. We don't just renovate; we wire your business for speed. Our M&E services include: Structured Cabling: Cat6 LAN cables pulled to every workstation for stable internet. Server Rack Setup: Organizing your routers, switches, and patch panels neatly. Floor Boxes: Installing metal floor sockets under desks to avoid messy extension cords tripping your staff. 5. Moving Out? Office Reinstatement If you are ending your tenancy, your landlord will require you to return the unit to its "original bare condition." This service is called Reinstatement. We handle the messy work so you get your rental deposit back: Hacking down all partitions and built-ins. Removing wiring and capping off electrical points. Removing carpet glue and grinding the floor. Applying a fresh coat of white paint. Planning an Office Fit-Out? Get a free site measurement and space planning consultation today. Get Corporate Quote 6. Office Renovation Cost Guide (KL 2026) Commercial renovation is priced by square footage (sqft). Below are estimates for a standard Grade A office in Kuala Lumpur. Service Item Estimated Unit Cost Gypsum Partition RM 12 - RM 18 per sqft Tempered Glass Partition RM 35 - RM 55 per sqft Carpet Tiles (Supply & Install) RM 4.50 - RM 8.00 per sqft Data/Power Point RM 120 - RM 180 per point Full Reinstatement RM 8 - RM 15 per sqft Why RK Reno Solution? We understand the corporate world. We know you have a launch date to meet. With RK Reno Solution, you get: Night & Weekend Work: We work while you sleep to meet tight deadlines. One-Stop Solution: No need to hire a separate plumber, electrician, and carpenter. Itemized Billing: Clear invoices for your finance department. extraSections.text: Post by raoisrar Apr 04 2026 No Comments Guides › Waterproofing › Maintenance PU Injection Waterproofing KL: How to Fix Wall Cracks Permanently By RK Reno Waterproofing Experts 6 Minute Read Kuala Lumpur, MY Are you noticing yellow water stains spreading across your ceiling? Or perhaps a distinct, jagged crack on your concrete wall that starts weeping every time there is a heavy downpour? In Malaysia's relentless tropical climate, water leakage is a common but devastating issue. Left untreated, water ingress weakens your property’s structural integrity and invites dangerous black mold. For decades, the only way to fix a leaking concrete slab or inter-floor bathroom leak was to hack away tiles, pour new cement, and endure weeks of dust and noise. Fortunately, technology has evolved. If you are searching for a reliable wall crack repair service KL, the ultimate modern solution is PU Injection Waterproofing. At RK Reno Solution, we specialize in this "no-hack" method to stop leaks dead in their tracks. Table of Contents 1. What is PU Injection Waterproofing? 2. Why Do Concrete Walls & Ceilings Crack? 3. How the PU Grouting Process Works (No Hacking) 4. 2026 Cost Guide for PU Injection in KL 5. Why Choose RK Reno for Wall Crack Repair? 1. What is PU Injection Waterproofing? PU stands for Polyurethane. PU Injection (also known as PU Grouting) is an advanced waterproofing technique used specifically to stop active water leaks through cracks in concrete structures. The Science Behind It Liquid polyurethane resin is injected directly into the concrete crack using a high-pressure pump. The magic happens when this resin comes into contact with the water trapped inside the wall. It reacts instantly, expanding up to 30 times its original volume to form a dense, tough, waterproof foam. This foam perfectly fills every microscopic void, permanently sealing the water's path. Because it specifically targets the inside of the concrete slab, it is the most effective PU injection waterproofing KL residents can use for basement leaks, leaking RC flat roofs, and dripping plaster ceilings originating from the bathroom above. 2. Why Do Concrete Walls & Ceilings Crack? Concrete is strong, but it is not invincible. If you are looking for a wall crack repair service KL, your property is likely suffering from one of the following: Thermal Expansion: Kuala Lumpur experiences scorching heat followed by sudden, freezing thunderstorms. This rapid temperature change causes concrete to expand and contract daily, eventually leading to hairline fractures. Building Settlement: As a new house settles into the ground over its first few years, the structural shift naturally causes minor cracks in the walls and foundation. Degraded Waterproofing Membranes: The original waterproofing layer laid by the developer under your bathroom tiles usually degrades after 5 to 10 years, allowing water to seep into the concrete slab. 3. How the PU Grouting Process Works (No Hacking) The greatest advantage of PU injection is that it requires zero hacking. You don't have to destroy your beautiful, expensive bathroom tiles to fix the leak underneath them. Here is our step-by-step process: Step 1: Leak IdentificationWe inspect the yellow stains or dripping areas on your ceiling or wall to identify the exact path of the water. Step 2: Drilling Injection HolesWe drill small, highly precise holes (about 45 degrees) intersecting the crack in the concrete slab. Step 3: Inserting PackersWe insert mechanical injection packers (metal valves) into the drilled holes. These will act as the gateway for the resin. Step 4: High-Pressure InjectionUsing a specialized high-pressure machine, we pump the liquid polyurethane resin through the packers. You will literally see the expanding foam push the trapped water out of the crack before sealing it completely. Step 5: Curing & FinishingOnce the foam cures (hardens), we remove the packers, clean off the excess foam, and patch the drill holes with waterproof cement. Stop the Leak Before It Ruins Your Home Water damage gets more expensive every day you ignore it. Get a professional PU injection assessment today. Book a Free Inspection 4. 2026 Cost Guide for PU Injection in KL Unlike traditional hacking methods which cost thousands of Ringgit in new tiles, cement, and labor, PU Injection is incredibly cost-effective. Pricing is typically calculated "per point" (the number of injection packers needed to cover the length of the crack). Waterproofing Method Estimated Cost (RM) Notes PU Injection Grouting RM 150 - RM 300 per point Best for active leaks in concrete ceilings, RC flat roofs, and basement walls. Minimum call-out fee applies. Clear Nano Penetrative Coating RM 800 - RM 1,500 per bathroom An alternative no-hack method. Clear liquid applied over existing tiles to seal porous grout lines. Traditional Tile Hacking RM 3,500 - RM 6,000+ per bathroom Full bathroom remodeling during a house renovation. Involves hacking, new cementitious waterproofing, and new tiles. 5. Why Choose RK Reno for Wall Crack Repair? PU Injection requires immense precision. If the pressure is too low, the resin won't reach the deepest part of the crack. If the pressure is too high, it can further damage the concrete. That is why you need an experienced Waterproofing Contractor Kuala Lumpur. The RK Warranty Promise We don't just promise dry walls; we guarantee them in writing. All our PU Injection and waterproofing services come with a solid warranty. If the treated crack leaks again within the warranty period, we will return and fix it completely free of charge. Don't let a small crack turn into a major structural failure. Contact RK Reno Solution today for the most reliable PU injection and wall crack repair service in KL and Selangor.
